correctness.rationale: Base-q two-sum relations are identical to 0/1-incidence-vector sums; face-deletion relations generate the lattice group Z^d. Each coordinate clamp is a graph map and adjacent clamps are digraph-homotopic, killing finite-support reduced integral cycles. The lattice-cover GLMY modules are free over the deck group ring because each local integer kernel is free. Acyclicity and coinvariants compute the integer group homology of rank-d free abelian N, yielding exterior powers. The independent packaged finite verifier checks all short relations, local clamps, alternating top cycles and determinant cocycles for three examples.

originality.rationale: Checked actual indexed records and both primary full texts. The abstract 2-cover theorem is prior, but neither its short-relation criterion nor published rectangle, Sidon, and three-step calculations establish the acyclic-lift lemma for arbitrary face-downsets. The new lemma and all-face integral specialization are original to the checked record, with explicitly stated possibility of an overlooked broad corollary.
residual_risks: The cited general two-cover theorem plus a known but unindexed downset contractibility result could subsume this specialization.
Semantic search ranking is not an exhaustive literature database; published equivalents may be unindexed.
The finite example verifier does not calculate full integral Smith normal forms; full integral freeness relies on the proved free deck-group resolution.

value.rationale: Arbitrary simplicial complexes yield a broad natural family with unbounded many interacting shortcut faces and pair-sum collisions. Their entire torsion-free integral GLMY homology is invariant under all higher-face additions, a meaningful all-degree classification beyond previously tabulated singleton or rectangular special cases. The all-downset acyclicity lemma is the structural contribution; mere correctness/reproducibility was not used as a surrogate for value.
